說明: 《畫海人》港口、港口設施、各島的遠景（景_），和海圖每一頁的裝飾（圖_）。畫面沒有人。橫的 16:9，存成 img/place/名稱-1600.webp 與 -800.webp。景_ 的名稱是港口設施名或島名（畫海人/js/islands.js 的 ISLANDS），圖_ 的名稱是海域名（SEAS）或「第六頁」。

style.place: Pure environment art with no characters: an uninhabited place where no person, figure or traveler appears anywhere, not even a tiny one in the distance. Anime film background art, hand-painted with soft painterly brushwork and rich environmental detail. Medieval European fantasy setting. Muted, slightly dark color grading: desaturated slate grey, deep sea blue and moss green in the shadows and skies; warm amber-gold light comes only from the light sources that the description below mentions (for example a lantern, a hearth, a forge or a sunset), with soft bloom. Atmospheric haze, quiet melancholic mood. One single continuous wide establishing shot filling the whole 16:9 frame, the main subject in the middle, the top and bottom edges calm and simple. No text, letters or numbers anywhere; any writing is drawn as abstract squiggles. Show only what the description below asks for.
style.chart: Illustration of an antique hand-drawn sea chart on aged parchment, seen flat from above and filling the whole 16:9 frame, in the same hand-painted anime film style as the game's scenes: ink line work with pale watercolour washes, slightly dark and muted, warm candle-gold tint on the parchment. Medieval European cartography style with decorative waves and a compass rose. No text, letters or numbers anywhere; any writing is drawn as abstract squiggles. No hands, no people, no table.

items.name: 景_港口
items.prompt: A small medieval European harbour town on a grey island at dusk: stone and timber houses with slate roofs climbing a hillside, a stone quay with moored sailing ships, a lighthouse on the point, warm windows lighting up, gulls, mist over the sea.

items.name: 景_碼頭
items.prompt: A wooden supply dock: crates, barrels, coiled ropes and sacks stacked along the pier, a moored sailing ship, an iron-framed oil lantern on a post glowing warm, grey sea mist.

items.name: 景_酒館
items.prompt: Indoors only. A cosy harbour tavern interior: dark timber beams, a long wooden bar with mugs, round tables, a crackling hearth, a notice board covered with pinned papers showing only abstract scribbles, iron-framed oil lanterns.

items.name: 景_鐵匠
items.prompt: Indoors only. A blacksmith’s forge interior: a glowing stone furnace, an anvil with a hammer, tongs and tools hanging on the wall, sparks, warm orange firelight against dark stone.

items.name: 景_船塢
items.prompt: A covered shipyard: a sailing ship hull on wooden slipways under a timber roof, scaffolding, stacks of planks, tools, an iron-framed oil lantern, grey sea beyond the open end.

items.name: 景_市場
items.prompt: An open-air harbour market street: stalls with striped awnings, baskets of shells, fish, cloth and coral, stone houses behind, overcast sky, a few warm lamps.

items.name: 景_黑市
items.prompt: Indoors only. An empty, deserted hidden smugglers’ cellar after closing time: low stone vault, crates with red cloth, barrels, an empty wooden stool, a pirate flag hanging on the wall, candlelight, dark corners.

items.name: 景_天文台
items.prompt: Indoors only. An old observatory dome interior: a large brass telescope pointing through an opening in the roof to a starry sky, star charts with abstract lines pinned on the walls, a brass orrery, candlelight.

items.name: 景_低語礁
items.prompt: A rocky reef islet with an old stone lighthouse on top, whispering mist curling around the rocks, grey sea, the lighthouse lamp glowing warm.

items.name: 景_晨忘島
items.prompt: A small village island at dawn: stone cottages around a bell tower with a large bronze bell, dew on the grass, pale morning mist, first warm sunrise light.

items.name: 景_沉船灣
items.prompt: A grey bay full of shipwrecks: broken masts and hulls of sunken ships sticking out of the water, rusted anchors on the shore, thick fog.

items.name: 景_千帆市
items.prompt: A busy trading city on a coral island: hundreds of moored sailing ships with furled sails, warehouses, a counting house with a clock tower, canals, overcast sky.

items.name: 景_雙影嶼
items.prompt: Twin islands mirrored in calm water, a narrow sandbar between them, surveying poles and measuring stakes on the beach, two shadows on the water.

items.name: 景_珠母潟湖
items.prompt: A turquoise-grey lagoon inside a coral ring, a great old stone tide gate closing the lagoon off from the sea, giant pearl shells in the shallows.

items.name: 景_帳房島
items.prompt: An island with a tall stone counting tower full of windows, stone stairs, white bleached coral reefs around it, everything strangely still and pale.

items.name: 景_紅帆港
items.prompt: A pirate harbour under a smoking volcano: ships with red sails, a wooden fortress of piers and rope bridges, ash-grey sky, warm firelight.

items.name: 景_鐵喉礦坑
items.prompt: A mine entrance cut into a dark mountainside: rail tracks for mine carts, wooden supports, miner lamps glowing, piles of ore, smoke.

items.name: 景_鍛火嶼
items.prompt: A volcanic island with an old stone forge building whose chimney glows, black lava rocks, cooling lava streams, embers in the air.

items.name: 景_紅岬
items.prompt: A red rock cape with a grey stone fortress on top, a sleeping volcano behind, red cliffs above a dark sea.

items.name: 景_灰燈渡
items.prompt: A misty ferry crossing in the north: a long wooden jetty lined with grey iron-framed oil lanterns, a small ferry boat, snow on the posts, thick fog.

items.name: 景_鏡冰湖
items.prompt: A frozen lake as smooth as a mirror, the roofs of a sunken city faintly visible under the ice, snowy hills, pale cold light.

items.name: 景_斷桅灣
items.prompt: A frozen bay where a fleet of old sailing ships is locked in the ice, broken masts, frost on the rigging, grey snowy sky.

items.name: 景_霧門
items.prompt: A colossal ancient stone gate standing alone in the frozen sea, a wall of white fog beyond it, two broken ice-covered stone pillars before it, bare snowy ice in front, snow.

items.name: 景_忘人港
items.prompt: A faded grey harbour where all the colour has drained away: empty piers, benches facing the sea, a single dock lamp glowing.

items.name: 景_無名島
items.prompt: A half-sunken island village: stone cottages half under water, a great white-blossom tree on the hill, petals on the water, soft mist.

items.name: 景_祈願塔
items.prompt: A tall white stone tower with a bell at its top rising from a drowned old city, a high waterline stain on the walls, kneeling stone statues around its base.

items.name: 景_畫室
items.prompt: Indoors only. A vast painter’s studio: walls covered with framed grey seascape paintings stacked to the ceiling, a huge drawing table, ink pots, a tall window with fog.

items.name: 景_霧心
items.prompt: The heart of the fog: a calm sea under a blank white sky, a single small island of white blank paper-like ground in the middle, faint gold and blue pen lights.

items.name: 景_醉鯨礁
items.prompt: A reef where a huge old whale sleeps half out of the water like an island, barnacles on its back, empty bottles floating, moonlight.

items.name: 景_沉金船
items.prompt: A great golden merchant ship sunk in clear shallow water on a sandbar, gold coins scattered on the sand, sunset light.

items.name: 景_紅帆藏寶島
items.prompt: A small tropical-grey island with a sea cave entrance, a tattered red pirate flag on a pole, palm-like trees, a hidden cove.

items.name: 景_冰下船塢
items.prompt: Indoors only. A secret shipyard frozen under ice: a half-built great ship on wooden slipways, ice ceiling glowing blue, frozen tools and scaffolding.

items.name: 景_墨潮島
items.prompt: A strange island drawn in ink: its coastline in blue ink, coral reefs in green ink, volcano in red ink and snow in white ink, flowing ink streams, painted mist.

items.name: 圖_淺灘
items.prompt: An old parchment sea chart of three small islands in shallow waters: a reef with a lighthouse, a bell tower island and a bay of shipwrecks, drawn with ink lines, a compass rose, waves drawn as little curls.

items.name: 圖_珊瑚環礁
items.prompt: An old parchment sea chart of a ring-shaped coral atoll with four islands inside, drawn with ink lines and pale watercolour, a compass rose, small ship drawings.

items.name: 圖_焰之群島
items.prompt: An old parchment sea chart of volcanic islands in the south with small smoking volcano drawings, red-tinted ink lines, a compass rose.

items.name: 圖_北霧海
items.prompt: An old parchment sea chart of the cold northern sea with icy islands and a great gate drawn in the north, pale blue ink lines, frost on the edges of the parchment.

items.name: 圖_霧心
items.prompt: An old parchment sea chart where the ink lines fade toward a blank empty centre, faint islands at the edges, a glowing spot in the middle.

items.name: 圖_第六頁
items.prompt: A glowing extra page of an old sea chart, one large island drawn in four colours of ink: blue, green, red and white, torn edges sewn together.
